bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to elections; transferring money to the voting operations, technology, and election resources account.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TRANSFER; VOTING OPERATIONS, TECHNOLOGY, AND ELECTION RESOURCES ACCOUNT.

$2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are transferred from the general fund to the voting operations, technology, and election resources account established under Minnesota Statutes, section 5.305.
additions: TRANSFER; VOTING OPERATIONS, TECHNOLOGY, AND ELECTION RESOURCES ACCOUNT.

$2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are transferred from the general fund to the voting operations, technology, and election resources account established under Minnesota Statutes, section 5.305.
